name: – Daniel Freund – § 247, after point iv – Am 28
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section III – Commission and executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (iv a) take the necessary measures to ensure that trainees who find themselves in a situation where they have reasonable grounds to believe that there is a serious and imminent danger or an infringement of their moral integrity, their rights, or their dignity, may immediately withdraw from that situation until it has ended or until they have been duly informed that the reasonably presumed danger or violation no longer exists. Exercising this right has no effect on the continuation of the internship, unless the intern decides otherwise. Nor does it affect the intern’s evaluation or compensation;
